deploy-bot: [deploy-start] Staging deploy started for service=inference-runtime environment=staging tag=v2.4.1-canary commit=9fa3c1b initiator=alex change-window=none

alex: kicking this off — smoke tests first. watching tok/cpu metrics and p99 latency.

jamie: on it, running quick e2e smoke now. will abort if error rate spikes or p99 > 300ms.

priya: observability dashboards are up: https://grafana.company/staging/inference-runtime — I've pinned the relevant panels to the release board.

ops-bot: smoke-step: healthcheck ok (200), redis ok, kv-cache warming started.

jamie: smoke logs look mostly clean. one warning about large prompt edge-case in reranker, low frequency.

alex: noted the reranker warning. don't rollback yet — let's finish canary traffic. If we see regressions we can pin back to v2.4.0 and roll back.

sandeep: tagging this for manual pin if needed. FYI deployment policy is canary=20% for 10m then 50% then full.

priya: running regression eval set now against canary. will post summary in ~5m.

jamie: quick command if we need an immediate pin/rollback:
```

infractl pin --env=staging --service=inference-runtime --tag=v2.4.0 --reason="regression"
```

alex: thanks. holding thumbs. :crossed_fingers:

deploy-bot: [deploy-finish] Staging deploy complete for inference-runtime tag=v2.4.1-canary commit=9fa3c1b duration=00:03:12 canary-instances=3/3 ready canary-traffic=20%

jamie: finished another round of prompts — latency +10ms p50, p95 steady, p99 +25ms but still under alert threshold. :thumbsup:

priya: regression eval done: 98.7% pass on eval set, minor reranker drift on 0.3% of cases. attaching short csv: https://files.company/summaries/1812345678-eval.csv

alex: ok, since metrics look within bounds and eval pass rate high, we'll let the canary proceed to 50% at next cadence. no immediate pin.

sandeep: noted. I'll update the rollout schedule to continue. If anything degrades ping @alex @jamie.

ops-bot: scheduled autoscale check at +10m. will report back.

jamie: leaving one monitor run active for 15m. will call for rollback if errors > 0.5% sustained.

alex: great work — closing thread unless we see issues.
